Legacy key for 2031 and 2035 Women's World Cup says sports executive

FAST

CALGARY, Canada, Nov 22 : Focusing on the legacy of the Women's World Cup should be the top priority for those organising the 2031 and 2035 tournaments, according to a sports executive behind the 2023 competition. In Zurich on Monday, FIFA will confirm that the United States, Jamaica, Costa Rica and Mexico will host in 2031, with England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland on co-hosting duties in 2035. Unlike Australia and New Zealand in 2023, there will be 48 teams rather than 32, streaming giant Netflix will have some involvement and the tournaments will be held in markets more mature in terms of women's soccer development than Australia. But for James Johnson, who was the CEO for Football Australia between 2020 and 2025 and is now the commissioner of the Canadian Premier League, legacy remains the fundamental driving force administrators should be thinking about.

"If you're focused on legacy, I think it helps the tournament," he told Reuters by Zoom from Calgary, Canada, after writing a book on his 2023 experience, "Hosting the World". "In Australia it was about moving the sport from a fourth, fifth or even sixth-tier sport into the mainstream, and we were able to accomplish that. "It is a different market for 2031 and 2035. But the legacy conversation starts as soon as the hosting is officially awarded to those countries." An imperative for Johnson in 2023 was that the Matildas made it to the last weekend of the tournament, something he ensured by fighting for long-term funding for the team. Getting to the third-placed playoff meant many weeks of exposure for women's soccer in a country more traditionally interested in cricket and rugby. 'BETTER OPPORTUNITIES' And although it has received some criticism elsewhere for diluting quality, Johnson believes the expansion to 48 teams for 2031 and 2035 provides an opportunity for the host countries to spend more time in the limelight. "The additional content, the additional matches, what I hope it translates into is better opportunities for the home teams because that's really the amplifier of culture and the amplifier of interest in the tournaments," he said. "A host nation taking the tournament by storm and staying in there from start to finish is a key for the success of the tournament - and the cultural impact you create as a result." Next year's Women's World Cup in Brazil will include the involvement of a major streamer for the first time, with Netflix securing rights in the US and Canada for that tournament and the 2031 competition, as well as expressing interest in the 2030 men's World Cup. Ahead of the 2023 World Cup FIFA were critical of some traditional broadcasters – especially in Europe – for what they said was an undervaluation of women's soccer. But while Johnson welcomed the arrival of Netflix, he cautioned against the long-term danger of locking out potential viewers who had previously watched on free-to-air. "It creates a new dynamic, it's interesting, it's healthy for the sport because there's more competitions," he said. "What I hope it doesn't do though is put too much content behind paywalls because I think the beauty of a World Cup is the community that it creates, and the buzz that it creates, and the ability to bring people together, which means it needs to be widely distributed."

Source: Reuters

Nov 22 : After an eight-year journey, the European-Japanese spacecraft BepiColombo has begun orbiting the solar system's smallest and innermost planet Mercury, though the European Space Agency said on Sunday a glitch has occurred involving its thrusters. Mercury, only slightly larger than Earth's moon, is the least explored of the four planets in the inner solar system, with BepiColombo only the third spacecraft to visit the planet and just the second to orbit it. It is a joint mission of the European Space Agency, or ESA, and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency, or JAXA. ESA confirmed on Saturday that BepiColombo had begun its orbit. In a social media post on Sunday, ESA said the spacecraft had a successful entry into orbit, but during the maneuver, "the thruster burn was shorter than planned following a software issue."

"The spacecraft is safe and teams at ESOC (the European Space Operations Centre) are working to understand what happened," ESA said, adding that "updates will be provided on Monday." The robotic spacecraft, launched in 2018, is a composite of ESA's Mercury Planetary Orbiter and JAXA's Mercury Magnetospheric Orbiter, which have different scientific objectives and are due to separate on December 9 and 10. Routine science operations are slated to commence in April. The mission will seek to answer questions about Mercury such as why it has a magnetic field, why ice exists in the polar craters of a sun-scorched planet, and what is the nature of enigmatic depressions called "hollows" on its surface. Mercury's surface looks similar to that of the moon, with numerous impact craters. There are expanses of smooth terrain as well as cliffs, some up to a mile (1.6 km) tall. Mercury is about 60 per cent closer to the sun than Earth. That means that from its surface, the sun appears more than three times as large and seven times as luminous as it does when seen from Earth. Mercury's diameter of 3,032 miles (4,880 km) is less than 40 per cent of Earth's diameter of 7,926 miles (12,753 km).

Source: Reuters

LIVERPOOL, England, Nov 22 : Mauricio Pochettino insisted Manchester United's players had shown fight and commitment despite a humiliating 4-0 defeat at Liverpool in his first game in charge, rejecting suggestions the club's dire start to the season pointed towards a relegation battle. United remain 19th in the Premier League table with one win from 11 games after a crushing loss at Anfield on Sunday, where Leny Yoro's eighth-minute red card left the visitors facing an uphill struggle for more than 80 minutes. "We need to accept the reality and we need to be responsible, we need to be united, we need to be all together," Pochettino said, when asked what he had learned about the size of the task facing him. "What I learned from my players is that they like to fight, they commit with the team, with the club, and of course they want to win games. They want to make the effort.

"Today was a test that, for me, is very positive. After eight minutes, 10 men, red card, concede the goal in this action and then 80 minutes to play. Do you think that it's easy?" The defeat was the joint heaviest for a United manager in his first match in charge, according to Opta, equalling the 4-0 loss to Bolton Wanderers suffered by Lal Hilditch in 1926. The Argentine, who was hired after the sacking of Michael Carrick and arrived in Manchester only on Wednesday after a stint with the United States national team, said the dismissal of Yoro fundamentally altered the contest and repeatedly returned to the sending-off when assessing his side's performance. "Even the best team in the world playing like this in this situation, in our circumstance, maybe concede four goals or maybe more." Pochettino also questioned the decision itself, arguing that Liverpool striker Alexander Isak did not have the ball under control when Yoro brought him down. 'APPLAUDING RUBBISH' Former United captain Roy Keane was among those unimpressed by attempts to find positives in the defeat, questioning why the United supporters still in the stadium at the final whistle applauded the players. "Fans are applauding the players, applauding what? Applauding rubbish," Keane said. "When do the players take responsibility for some of the decision making? "Liverpool should have scored eight or nine. I feel like swearing." Pochettino, however, refused to dwell on criticism or wider questions about United's defensive record after the team conceded four goals for the third time this season across all competitions. "It's painful because it's 4-0 at the end and you lose the game. But you need to (consider) the circumstances," he said. "We are not going to lose more than one game how we lose today. We have a lot of work to do." With a Champions League trip to Portugal to face Sporting on Wednesday, Pochettino said his message in the dressing room was simple. "They are very, very, very low," he said. "But I said, 'head up, and we need to keep working, be concentrated, try to go to Portugal and try to win the game'."

Source: Reuters

FAST

TURIN, Italy, Nov 22 : Seven-times Grand Slam champion Carlos Alcaraz powered past world number one Alexander Zverev 6-2 7-6(7) on Sunday to win his maiden ATP Finals title. The Spaniard, who came back at the US Open after a four-month break due to a wrist injury, saved three set points in the tiebreak before completing his 14th consecutive victory and ending the year with a third straight title, having also triumphed in Vienna and Paris. The 23-year-old, who is the youngest man to have completed the career Grand Slam, secured the biggest tour title that had eluded him after finishing runner-up at the ATP Finals last year. Since losing in the quarter-finals of the US Open, he has won four titles with a 22-1 record.

"For me it's been an amazing week," Alcaraz said. "I couldn't have ended the week in a better way. I'm just really proud and really happy with everything I have done this week." "I've been through really difficult moments within myself, with my team, and we went through everything playing great tennis. This trophy is something I have been chasing for a really long time. It means the world to me." For Zverev, the defeat brought an end to his most successful season, in which he won his first two Grand Slam titles and rose to the top of the world rankings. Alcaraz initially faced little resistance from a sluggish Zverev, who had not dropped a set en route to the final. The German struggled with his usually booming serve and made 19 unforced errors in the first set. What had been billed as a blockbuster turned out to be a one-man show after Alcaraz bagged an early break to love to take control of the first set.  Zverev, a two-time ATP Finals champion, had saved all six break points he had faced during the group stage but on Sunday he was struggling to keep pace with Alcaraz from the start. The Spaniard earned five break points during the German's first two service games, converting one of them. By the end of the fifth game, Zverev had racked up 15 unforced errors. While the Spaniard buzzed around the court with his trademark intensity, chasing down every ball and nodding along to the music in the arena during the changeovers, Zverev looked sluggish and slow. He did earn one break back to cut Alcaraz's lead to 4-2 but only three points later his frustration boiled over when he argued with the umpire over a time violation warning. The second set looked to be following a similar pattern with Alcaraz keeping the level high and earning another early break. But Zverev won three games on the trot to lead 5-4 and eventually forced a tiebreak. He could not convert any of his three consecutive set points, however, before Alcaraz clinched the win.

Source: Reuters

Finnish, Russian and Estonian vessels battle the Sparta II fire before Russia takes over the rescue as the ship heads out of Finnish waters.

Finnish Border Guard's handout photo of the Russian cargo ship Sparta II as the extinguishing of the fire continues in the Gulf of Finland November 22, 2026. Finnish Border Guard/Handout via REUTERS

HELSINKI: A Russian rescue vessel on Sunday ( Nov 22) began towing a Russian-owned cargo ship that was struck by drones in the Baltic Sea out of Finnish waters after two days of firefighting, Finland's coast guard said. The Finnish military has said the strike on the Sparta II on Saturday was likely carried out by Ukraine and that the vessel later drifted into Finnish waters. The 16 crew members were evacuated onto a nearby Russian ship. One crew member was slightly injured. "Thermal cameras show that some containers are warm, but the vessel is stable enough for towing to begin," Finland's coast guard said in a statement. It said that responsibility for the rescue will transfer to Russia once the ship leaves Finnish waters.

Pictures and video released earlier by the Finnish coast guard showed several vessels spraying the Sparta II with water cannons during the night in a bid to put out the flames and cool down containers stacked on its deck. In a rare instance of cross-border collaboration, out of the seven vessels helping to fight the fire, two were Russian, two were Estonian and the rest were Finnish. Estonia and Finland are members of NATO and steadfast supporters of Ukraine and often at odds with Moscow on other issues. Finland shut all of its land border crossings with Russia in 2023. Estonia will shut its own from December 1, for six months, on security grounds.

Related:

Russian cargo ship hit by drones in Baltic, Finland tightens security

BOUND FOR KALININGRAD The ship, bound for the Russian exclave Kaliningrad, was damaged in international waters west of Russia's Gogland island, Finland's Defence Forces have said, corroborating an account by Russian officials. "Smoke is still coming from the vessel, and there is clearly still heat on board," Jukka-Pekka Lumilahti, sea safety officer and commander of the maritime sub-centre Helsinki for the Finnish Border Guard, told a press conference earlier on Sunday. NEW DRONE ATTACKS POSSIBLE Kyiv has sent waves of military drones towards the Leningrad region on Russia's northwest coast this year, including some that strayed into the airspace of nearby Baltic countries, leading to fears that the war was spilling onto NATO territory. The risk of further attacks in the Gulf of Finland, a narrow arm of the Baltic Sea, cannot be ruled out, Estonian Navy Commander Ivo Vark told public broadcaster ERR on Sunday. Finland's military said last week it had detected a strike on a Russian warship in the same area during Ukrainian drone attacks. The Sparta II is a 121-m (397-foot) Russian-flagged cargo vessel owned by Russian shipping company Oboronlogistika that left St Petersburg on Friday, according to LSEG data. Oboronlogistika provides logistics services for the Russian Defence Ministry, according to the company's website. The vessel is subject to US sanctions, according to the US Treasury Department. Lumilahti said one concern was the weather, with rain, sleet, and stronger winds expected on Sunday night and Monday.

Source: Reuters/fs

Nov 22 : Brazilian rookie Rafael Camara will race for Haas in the final two rounds of the Formula One season in Qatar and Abu Dhabi in a move that effectively ends his Formula Two title hopes. The 21-year-old made his F1 debut at home in Sao Paulo this month and remained in the seat for Saturday's Las Vegas Grand Prix. Camara leads Red Bull-backed Bulgarian Nikola Tsolov by seven points in the F2 standings and Ireland's Alex Dunne by 18, but will not be able to defend that advantage in the final two rounds of the support series at the Middle Eastern circuits. Brazil and Las Vegas did not feature F2 races and he cannot do both on the same weekend.

"I’m delighted that Rafa’s embraced every track session as a learning opportunity and embedded himself further within the team. We now get to finish the season together which is advantageous to us all ahead of a relatively short off-season and as our 2027 preparations get underway.” Camara finished 16th in Saturday's race after a collision with Cadillac's Sergio Perez, which brought the Mexican a five-place grid drop for Qatar.

FAST

LIVERPOOL, England, Nov 22 : The scale of Mauricio Pochettino's rebuilding job was laid bare on Sunday as Manchester United crashed to a 4-0 Premier League defeat at Liverpool, their first match under the Argentine unravelling within minutes. Reduced to 10 men after eight minutes, United fell two goals behind within 13 and never recovered as Liverpool cruised to victory through goals from Dominik Szoboszlai, Florian Wirtz, teenager Rio Ngumoha and Victor Munoz. United's nightmare start to the Pochettino era could hardly have been worse as Leny Yoro was sent off for bringing down Alexander Isak, and the visitors paid the price moments later when Szoboszlai curled home the resulting free kick. Liverpool doubled their lead three minutes later when Ngumoha beat Diogo Dalot and crossed for Wirtz, who finished with an acrobatic volley, swivelling and firing home while turning his back to goal.

The goal had Liverpool fans chanting "Sacked in the morning!" at United's new 54-year-old manager, who had arrived in England only four days earlier following his spell with the United States national team. The Reds attacked in waves after the break and the 18-year-old Ngumoha added a third in the 66th minute, sweeping home a cross from Bradley Barcola to become the youngest player to score in a Premier League match between Liverpool and United. Substitute Munoz added to United's misery when he fired home a ball from Wirtz, sending United fans streaming towards the exits. The few who were left by the final whistle serenaded the United players with Bob Marley’s “Three Little Birds” and its hopeful refrain: “Every little thing is gonna be all right.” "So, so painful. So disappointed," Pochettino said. "It's not in your head to start here in the Premier League in this situation. The only problem was that the game changed completely after (eight) minutes and now we can talk and explain everything, but the damage is done. "The players are feeling the pain of this type of situation. I told them they need to be calm and it was a completely unfair situation that happened." Liverpool climbed to fourth on 21 points, seven behind leaders Arsenal, while beleaguered United are 19th with just eight points and one victory to show from 11 games. RECORD-EQUALLING DEFEAT Pochettino is only the second of the Red Devils' last 10 managers, including caretakers, to lose his first league game in charge after Erik ten Hag. It was the joint heaviest defeat for a United manager in his first match in charge, according to Opta, equalling the 4-0 loss to Bolton Wanderers suffered by Lal Hilditch in 1926. United's winless league run is their worst since they went 11 games without a win between November 1989 and February 1990. Liverpool, meanwhile, ran roughshod over United all afternoon, recording 27 shots - including a remarkable 12 on target - to their visitors' 11, and had 15 corners to United's five. "It was definitely important today, also the table situation," said Wirtz. "A lot of teams at the top didn't win this weekend so it's good we can use the chance. "The red card influenced the game of course, but we take that. We earned that because of the run of Alex (Isak), so it's very good." Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola had kind words for Wirtz, who created 10 chances. "He's in a lovely moment and we want to keep him there as much as we can," Iraola said. "He's in a situation against 10 players where you need players like him to control the situation and see the passes in behind. "He's also arriving more and not just scoring but being a threat. He's becoming another option and I'm happy with him."

Source: Reuters

WASHINGTON, Nov 22 : Americans should expect more technology outages and disruptions as companies and government agencies replace aging systems, the top US intelligence official said on Sunday. "And as part of that ongoing upgrade, we are going to have glitches, gaps, interruptions in service," Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton told CNN's "State of the Union" program. "That is going to happen." Clayton was interviewed on Sunday morning news programs days after President Donald Trump attributed a recent spate of technology failures to upgrades of companies' technology systems. Clayton said the upgrades were necessary to improve performance and cybersecurity as technological advances strain older systems. A string of technology failures this month disrupted critical US systems, including a nationwide halt to air travel, a Microsoft outage that hit email services, a technical glitch that affected several major banks and a temporary disruption to the National Security Agency's network.

Nov 22 (Reuters) – Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis said on Sunday they had carried out an operation targeting Saudi Arabia’s Rabigh oil refinery on the kingdom’s western Red Sea coast, as they continued to claim attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure.

The Houthis said they had achieved a direct hit but there was no indication of what damage had been inflicted and the Saudi authorities did not immediately comment.

Rabigh is home to Petro Rabigh, a major integrated oil refining and petrochemical complex developed by Saudi Aramco and Japan’s Sumitomo Chemical. It is located about 165 km north of Jeddah on the Red Sea coast and has access to deep-water export facilities.

Show Full Article

The Houthis have repeatedly claimed attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure in recent months, including the East-West oil pipeline and refineries in Jazan in the south and Ras Tanura in Eastern Province. Saudi authorities have not confirmed any attacks on refineries.

The renewed fighting, which began in July amid the wider US-Israeli war with Iran, has seen the Houthis seize territory from Yemen’s internationally recognised government and step up missile and drone attacks on Saudi airports and energy infrastructure.

Saudi Arabia has also intensified airstrikes against Houthi positions in support of its Yemeni allies.

(Reporting by Hatem Maher and Ahmed Tolba; Editing by Susan Fenton and David Holmes)

By Katharine Jackson WASHINGTON, Nov 22 (Reuters) – The US is seeking answers from Nvidia on its chip sales to China and will find out who was in charge of compliance at the company formerly led by Jensen Huang, who resigned following an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Sunday.

“We’ve been in touch with the temporary management, with the lead directors, with their lawyers, and we do need answers. … It behooves Nvidia to move quickly on this because we want to know what the culture was,” Bessent told the CBS program “Face the Nation.”

Reports about Huang’s relationship with a woman whom US intelligence suspects of being a Chinese spy and his extramarital affair with a company executive led to his resignation and investigations by US regulators and the FBI, congressional action, an internal review and a proposed investor class-action lawsuit.

Show Full Article

Days after Huang’s resignation, President Donald Trump’s administration issued a rule to further restrict China’s access to advanced AI chips from companies like Nvidia, tightening controls ahead of Trump’s trip to China last week for talks with President Xi Jinping.

Bessent said the chipmaker’s board of directors is working to determine what had happened, and he expressed confidence that it would “come up with some very fulsome and robust answers.”

“We do need to see who was in charge of compliance there,” Bessent said. “We will see which level of the business knew about this. Was it at the lower levels? Was it at the middle level? Did it go all the way to the top?”

Trump said on Friday that he would like to see Huang apologize and return to Nvidia. Asked whether he agreed with Trump, Bessent said more information is needed.

“I think we have to see where the buck stops,” Bessent said.

Nvidia board Chairman Harvey Jones has said the board will not rehire Huang.

(Reporting by Katharine Jackson; Editing by Sergio Non, Will Dunham and Bill Berkrot)

HULL, England, Nov 22 : Hull City manager Sergej Jakirovic hailed his side's collective effort after they earned their first Premier League victory since August with a 2-0 win over Brighton & Hove Albion on Sunday, thanks to an injury-time double from Oli McBurnie. The result ended promoted Hull's eight-match winless run and lifted them further clear of the relegation zone with 14 points from 11 games, while preventing Brighton from cutting the gap to leaders Arsenal. "We played against an excellent team today, very high intensity," Jakirovic told Sky Sports. "We won 2-0 and I'm extremely happy because we wait almost three months (for another win) which is unbelievable, but I have never been in the Premier League before."

GOALKEEPING MASTERCLASS KEEPS BRIGHTON AT BAY Hull were forced to withstand sustained pressure early on, with goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis producing a string of superb saves to preserve parity. The Greek stopper made five saves in the first half, including a brilliant one-handed stop from Diego Gomez's effort in the 15th minute, helping Hull survive before they grew into the contest after the break. "In the first half we survived and Konstantinos Tzolakis saved us four or five times. We had more stability in the second half," Jakirovic said. Brighton's task became harder when Joao Costinha was sent off late on after collecting a second yellow card, and McBurnie made the extra man count, striking twice in stoppage time to seal a smash-and-grab victory. "I never had doubt in Oli McBurnie because I know what he means to the team," Jakirovic added. "We have to create chances for McBurnie and he will score. No matter if we win or lose, it is always a good atmosphere in the dressing room." BRIGHTON RUE WASTED OPPORTUNITIES Brighton manager Fabian Huerzeler lamented his side's wastefulness after they failed to convert their chances despite controlling large spells of the game. "That's football. The Premier League is ruthless. Hull scored with a lucky punch, we have to accept it and be better next time," Huerzeler told Sky Sports, adding that his side lost intensity after the 65th minute. "We rushed things, we lost a bit of intensity, we tried to force things because we weren't patient enough," he said. "You can easily get frustrated if you miss so many chances." Brighton host Newcastle United next Sunday, when Hull visit Crystal Palace.

Source: Reuters

By John Kruzel WASHINGTON, Nov 22 (Reuters) – Russian President Vladimir Putin is not a friend when it comes to Ukraine, US Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said on Sunday, days after President Donald Trump spoke warmly of Russia’s leader.

“He is not America’s friend in Ukraine,” Clayton told ABC News’ “This Week” program. “Not at all.”

Asked about Trump’s recent description of Putin as a friend, Clayton also said the term was “entirely appropriate” in the context of discussions among leaders of the world’s three leading nuclear powers — the United States, Russia and China — during last week’s high-profile summit in China.

Show Full Article

Trump defended calling Putin a friend on Thursday, saying that “it’s nice to have people that have 4,000 nuclear weapons as a friend as opposed to an enemy.” But when asked about the subject again on Friday, Trump declined to say whether Putin is a friend to the United States as a whole: “I can’t speak to America.”

Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022 and controls about a fifth of the country’s territory. Putin has shown no sign of dropping his demand that Ukraine surrender all of its eastern Donbas region in exchange for peace.

Trump’s description of Putin as a friend drew criticism from European allies of Ukraine. “Mr Putin is not our friend and will never be,” Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said.

Asked on Thursday about Trump’s remarks, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy shrugged and walked away.

(Reporting by John Kruzel; Editing by Sergio Non and Bill Berkrot)

Nov 22 : Augsburg forward Michael Gregoritsch scored twice as his side beat Mainz 05 3-1 at home in Germany's Bundesliga on Sunday, overcoming the sending-off of their coach Manuel Baum to record their third win of the season.  Gregoritsch gave his side the lead in the 19th minute and Juma Bah added a second before Baum was red-carded for holding onto the ball to prevent Mainz midfielder Nadiem Amiri from taking a quick throw-in two minutes before the break.  Undeterred, Gregoritsch scored again three minutes into the second half, and though substitute Ransford Konigsdorffer pulled a goal back for Mainz shortly afterwards, that was as close as they came as Augsburg held on for a much-needed win.  The victory lifted Augsburg past Mainz and up to 10th place in the standings on 12 points after 10 games, with their visitors slipping to 13th on 10 points. In Sunday's late kick-off, Justin Njinmah grabbed a quick-fire double in the middle of the second half as Werder Bremen secured a 4-0 home win over Hamburg that leaves them sixth in the table on 18 points, six ahead of Hamburg, who are 12th.

item.description: Nov 22 : If Marc Marquez's 2025 MotoGP title ended a painful six-year wait, his record-equalling eighth premier-class crown a year later provided an even more compelling demonstration of his refusal to surrender.Marquez overturned a 102-point deficit, the largest in MotoGP history, and recovered from injuries

FAST

Nov 22 : If Marc Marquez's 2025 MotoGP title ended a painful six-year wait, his record-equalling eighth premier-class crown a year later provided an even more compelling demonstration of his refusal to surrender. Marquez overturned a 102-point deficit, the largest in MotoGP history, and recovered from injuries and two operations to climb from eighth in the standings and wrap up the championship in Portugal with a round to spare. The title drew him level with Giacomo Agostini on eight premier-class championships and took him clear of Valentino Rossi, whose bitter rivalry with the Spaniard became one of the sport's most polarising storylines. "Incredible! I need to smile. It was a season where I adapted to different circumstances. I understood in the first part of the season that the instinct was not working anymore," Marquez said.

"At one point even I felt that it was over, but the people around me - the team, my brother, girlfriend, family and Ducati - always believed in me. "They said, 'Please finish races and your moment will arrive'. And that's what I did." REBUILDING AN INJURY-HIT CAMPAIGN Marquez had already proved that he could win titles with his sheer speed and racecraft. This season required something different: the resilience to rebuild his campaign, recover from major setbacks and outthink an entire grid. There were legitimate concerns about whether the 33-year-old could return to his best, let alone challenge for another world title after undergoing two operations, on his shoulder and on a fractured foot. He rebuilt his campaign methodically, however, rediscovering the rhythm, confidence and attacking edge needed to unlock the Ducati's full potential. Seven rounds into the 2026 season, Marquez was without a single race win as the reigning champion looked out of sorts against a resurgent Aprilia's two-pronged attack of Jorge Martin and Marco Bezzecchi. Aprilia clearly had the faster bike at several circuits, but having two title contenders can be a mixed blessing. Ducati, by contrast, could focus support on Marquez as team mate Francesco Bagnaia struggled. Aprilia held the upper hand after Marquez crashed in the French Grand Prix sprint in May, an accident that led to the double surgery and forced the Spaniard to miss his home Catalan Grand Prix. "If I come back with the mentality that I can win this championship, I will be injured again," Marquez had said ahead of his return at the Italian Grand Prix in May. MARQUEZ SURGES UP THE STANDINGS After testing his physical limits in Italy, however, Marquez revived his challenge by winning six of the next nine rounds to surge up the standings. After Bezzecchi's own injury problems cost him the championship lead, Aprilia threw their weight behind Martin as the 2024 champion sought to leave the team on a high before his switch to Yamaha next season. By the time the paddock left Australia last month, however, Marquez had moved clear of Martin, who then missed the Malaysian Grand Prix with a fractured wrist to hand his compatriot a further advantage. "I tried to control my instincts. That was the biggest problem of my career," Marquez added. "And it's true that my instinct also gave me the chance to fight for a unique championship." Martin has won only one race in an injury-disrupted season, while Bezzecchi, who dropped to third in the standings, suffered costly setbacks at crucial moments. "Aprilia lost the championship because they fought against Marc. If not, it's impossible," Marquez's brother and Gresini Racing rider Alex said. Aprilia's internal rivalry handed Marquez an opening and he exploited it expertly, piling pressure on his rivals with his performances on the track and psychological manoeuvring in the paddock. When Martin suggested earlier this month that Marquez was the only one who could win or lose the championship, the Ducati rider confidently retorted with a smile: "They're the only ones who can lose it." And so, against two Aprilia challengers who had threatened to run away with the championship on a superior bike, Marquez used all his experience and guile to complete his coronation in Portugal, bringing his career full circle in the country where he took his first steps in motorcycle racing 18 years ago. With the shadow of a goat following him on the giant screen behind him, Marquez climbed a staircase in a theatrical nod to his "Greatest of All Time" credentials before Agostini presented him with a golden helmet, a fitting image of two riders at the summit of motorcycle racing.

Source: Reuters

FAST

BARCELONA, Nov 22 : Barcelona shook off a sloppy first half to beat Villarreal 3-2 in LaLiga on Sunday, coming back from two goals down against their opponents, who were reduced to 10 men. After a nightmarish start for Hansi Flick's side, a fading Villarreal could not cope with a persistent and fiery Barcelona in the second period. Barcelona remain top of the standings on 36 points, three ahead of Real Madrid after Jose Mourinho's side beat Celta Vigo on Saturday. Villarreal remain ninth on 15 points. Tajon Buchanan took just two touches to convert Fermin Lopez's lax giveaway into the opening goal for Villarreal after five minutes.

Alberto Moleiro released Tani Oluwaseyi into space on the left flank and the Canadian international added Villarreal's second with a powerful finish two minutes later. Even as Barcelona began to create chances, their game was plagued by errors, characterised by Lamine Yamal winning a penalty and then dragging it onto the post in the 23rd minute. Barcelona's comeback was finally ignited by Gerard Martin, who headed in a quickly taken short corner in the 57th minute. Pedri provided the cross for Martin's goal and was picked out for special praise by Flick after a dominant performance. "(His) game today was one of the best," Flick told a press conference. "How he controlled the midfield, how managed our game, increased the tempo, it was amazing." Fermin Lopez finished a brilliant move to level the score in the 61st minute. Centre-forward Raphinha had sprinted to the right-back spot to thwart a counter-attack and was involved again in a sequence that finished with Lamine Yamal finding Fermin on the left side of Villarreal's box. With Barcelona hungry for a third, what seemed like a mountainous task was completed in a matter of 10 minutes. Lamine Yamal's cross from the right was turned across the line by Villarreal defender Pau Navarro inside his own six-yard box. "When we're playing like this, the opponent gets tired," Flick said. "The second half was unbelievable how we played football, this hunger to come back and to score the goals, it was fantastic." Navarro was sent off in stoppage time for a second yellow as Barcelona saw out the victory.

Source: Reuters

Climate deal collapses in chaotic end to COP31

COP31 talks in Antalya break down after nearly 200 nations fail to bridge splits over fossil fuels, leaving no cover decision and no US$120 billion climate goal.

FAST

ANTALYA: The COP31 climate talks ended in failure Sunday (Nov 22)  as a contentious deal collapsed over fossil fuels and the summit stretched into record overtime in Türkiye .

The final agreement  was dramatically rejected in a chaotic finale to a UN climate summit which ran two days over schedule, underscoring the strains on diplomacy in an increasingly fractured world.

UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres, who urged nations to send fossil fuels "the way of the dinosaurs" during a fiery appearance at COP31, expressed deep dismay as the talks broke down.

"I share the very profound frustration of all those who expected governments to rise to the moment the climate crisis demands," the outgoing UN chief said in a statement.

COP31 negotiations chair Chris Bowen, who unsuccessfully sought to broker consensus among nearly 200 nations, conceded he could not overcome what he called "unbridgeable red lines".

"Unfortunately, we were unable to reach agreement on a cover decision... And that's disappointing. Very disappointing," Bowen, who is Australia's climate minister, told a throng of reporters.

More than 49 hours after the summit was supposed to end, COP31 President and Turkish Environment Minister Murat Kurum banged the gavel to conclude the marathon talks.

COP31 President Murat Kurum, center, leaves a closing plenary session at the COP31 U.N. Climate Summit, Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026, in Antalya, Turkey. (AP Photo/Khalil Hamra)

"GREENWASH" Bowen said the summit backdrop was "the most complicated and fraught geopolitical environment in living memory" as soaring energy prices and fallout from the Middle East war complicated the search for unity.

Under pressure to show progress in a year of climate-linked disasters from Europe to Nepal, Bowen sought an overarching "cover decision" to prove countries were still united in tackling the crisis.

But his plan unravelled as familiar fault lines emerged over fossil fuels, with the EU and Saudi Arabia locking horns over the pace of the shift away from coal, oil and gas.

The negotiations stalled as oil-producing states blocked any mention of phasing out fossil fuels in the final deal.

"We will not endorse a cover decision... that does not even mention fossil fuels, which is the key driver of climate change," said Ireland's climate minister, Darragh O'Brien, whose country holds the rotating EU presidency.

"And we will not accept a COP that greenwashes fossil fuel."

Panama, Vanuatu and the Marshall Islands also objected and as the deal imploded, COP31 became the longest climate summit on record.

Related:

Fossil fuels still missing from latest COP31 draft deal

FALLING SHORT The outcome revived memories of the failed Copenhagen summit of 2009 and raised fresh doubts about the effectiveness of climate diplomacy.

"It certainly fell short today," said UN climate chief Simon Stiell, describing progress over the marathon fortnight of negotiations in Antalya as "limited".

"The world cannot afford a repeat."

Frustrated by the inertia, countries are pushing ahead outside the COP process.

Around 60 countries joined a first-of-its-kind conference in April on phasing out fossil fuels while several nations at COP31 unveiled their own plans to exit coal, oil and gas.

In a last-ditch bid for compromise, COP31 hosts Türkiye and Australia could only muster a veiled reference to fossil fuels in the final text.

But the pact also took fire for retaining a call to expand carbon capture -- a costly technology championed by the fossil fuel industry.

"We believe that climate change requires all solutions on the table," said Mohammad Ayoub, a climate negotiator for oil giant Saudi Arabia.

Facing blowback over the fossil fuels omission, Türkiye and Australia tried to rally support behind a global goal to electrify the world economy.

They said "electrification" could cut heat-trapping emissions and bolster energy security but the target was ultimately torpedoed, along with the rest of the doomed Antalya Pact.

Related:

Climate crisis: COP31 president says there is no agreement on the draft text

"PROFOUND DISAPPOINTMENT" Countries lamented a missed opportunity to reinforce the Paris agreement's 1.5°C target, which scientists expect the world to overshoot in a few years as carbon-cutting goals fall short.

The summit also widened fault lines over science, with a fight over the work of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) spilling into the negotiations.

"We are profoundly disappointed by the substance of the cover decision," said UK climate negotiator Kate Hughes.

"It moves us backwards on the science... It is a lowest common denominator where it should have been, instead, presenting bold collective ambition on climate action."

As always, the summit laid bare the divide between major polluters driving climate change and smaller nations bearing the brunt of its impact.

Developing nations pushed for a US$120 billion target climate goal which disappeared from the failed deal.

Source: Reuters/dc/fs

MANCHESTER, England,, Nov 22 : Manchester City missed out on the chance to move into first place in the Women's Super League on Sunday, suffering a 3-1 defeat at home by Tottenham Hotspur that leaves them second in the standings.  With leaders Chelsea held to a 0-0 draw by Liverpool on Saturday, reigning champions City looked set to capitalise on that slip-up when they took a 1-0 lead thanks to a Bunny Shaw goal in the 10th minute. However, Norwegian striker Cathinka Tandberg levelled for Spurs just before the break.  City stuttered in attack and were punished in the 74th minute when Drew Spence sliced open their defence with a pass through the middle for Matilda Vinberg, who slotted home. Jessica Naz added another five minutes later on her 100th WSL appearance to make it 3-1. The defeat leaves City on 25 points after 11 games, two behind Chelsea and two ahead of third-placed London City Lionesses, while the win lifts Spurs to fifth on 20 points.

アンソロピックＩＰＯ、銀行に異例の制約　競合担当禁止や人数制限 11/22 22:09 配信

ニューヨークのタイムズスクエアで19日撮影　REUTERS/Shannon Stapleton/File Photo（ロイター） Echo Wang　Milana Vinn

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 過去最大規模となった米人工知能（ＡＩ）企業アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）。引き受け銀行は巨額の報酬を得たが、ＩＰＯの過程でアンソロピックが異例なほどの制約を銀行側にかけていたことが関係者の話で分かった。アンソロピックと並ぶ大型上場を遂げたスペースＸでも同様な状況だったという。

６月のスペースＸのＩＰＯでは、数カ月にわたる手続きをスペースＸが厳しく管理し、財務などの情報を開示しなかった。このためアドバイザーは業務を進めにくく、銀行の担当者らは不満を募らせた。

社内で「プロジェクト・ランタン」と呼ばれたアンソロピックのＩＰＯでも、銀行側は振り回された。直前の変更や財務見通しの共有の遅れ、慌ただしい書類承認、銀行に対する極めて異例の制約などだ。

関係者によると、アンソロピックは２２社の引受金融機関の一部に対し、案件に携わる要員を４人までに絞り、上級職員を充てるよう指示した。また銀行の一部の幹部に、法的文書への署名を求めた。案件チームの中核メンバーが上場後６カ月間、オープンＡＩ、カーソル、ディープシーク、ハギング・フェイスなどの競合企業と仕事をすることを制限する内容だった。

銀行は日常的に利益相反を管理し、顧客の機密を守っている。ＩＰＯでこれほどの制限を求めるのはまれで、まして銀行担当者個々に求めることは異例という。

＜情報漏えいに神経とがらす＞

こうした銀行に対する制約は、一つに情報漏えいを防ぐことが目的だった。

アンソロピックが米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）に提出した届出書「フォームＳ─１」が公開される４週間近く前に、ロイターはその内容を報じた。

アンソロピックは、案件を引き受けた大半の銀行との情報共有に、通常のＰＤＦではなく「ネットロードショー」と呼ばれるサービスを使った。

ネットロードショーは、誰が文書を閲覧し、どのページを見たかといったアクセスの詳細を記録する。ネットロードショー上の文書には、バンカー個人の名前が透かしとして入った。

その後もＩＰＯ書類に関する報道は続いた。関係者の１人によると、ネットロードショーの利用で銀行側の業務は煩雑になった。文書のコピーを保存できないことなどが理由だ。

アンソロピックは１０日に仮条件を記載した修正届出書「Ｓ─１Ａ」をＳＥＣに提出し、販売活動を始める予定だった。そのためには、シンジケート団の全銀行に草案を送り、承認を得る必要があるが、送付を巡って混乱があり、銀行側に届け出書がＳ─１Ａがネットロードショー経由で送られたのはニューヨーク時間午前２時ごろ。ＳＥＣへの提出に向け、銀行側に、承認のために与えられた時間は数時間しかなかったという。

銀行担当者からは「手続きが複雑な問題だらけで、これまで手掛けたどの案件とも違っていた」との声が出ている。

ＩＰＯを研究するフロリダ大学のジェイ・リッター名誉教授によると、スペースＸとアンソロピックはいずれも交渉により、グリーンシューオプション（追加売り出し）で売却する追加株式について、引受会社に手数料を一切支払わないことを取り付けた。「これらの企業には確かに、引受会社に対して『いつも通りにはいかない』と告げるだけの市場支配力があった」と指摘した。

アンソロピック、および両ＩＰＯで主幹事を務めたゴールドマン・サックスとモルガン・スタンレーはコメントを控えた。

スペースＸはコメント要請に応じなかった。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：人民元に内外の圧力、海外は割安批判　国内は元高懸念 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 コラム：安全資産性薄まる金　リスクオフでも買われず アングル：米ナスダック１００、10月に時価総額2兆ドル超消失　ＡＩ巨額投資に厳しい目 アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める 11/22(日) 22:09 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: ＣＯＰ３１が合意採択断念、ＥＵなど反対 化石燃料巡り対立
item.description:
Sarah McFarlane Peter Hobson
［アンタルヤ（トルコ） ２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sarah McFarlane　Peter Hobson

［アンタルヤ（トルコ） ２２日　ロイター］ - トルコのアンタルヤで開催されていた国連気候変動枠組み条約第３１回締約国会議（ＣＯＰ３１）は会期延長２日目となる２２日、共同議長国のトルコとオーストラリアが合意文書の新たな草案を公表したが、欧州連合（ＥＵ）などが反対し、採択を断念した。

議長を務めるトルコのムラト・クルム環境・都市計画・気候変動相は、閉会の全体会合で、「本文書についてコンセンサス（合意）がないことを認める。従って、これらの決定は採択されなかった」と述べた。「今後、新たな文書は出さない」とも述べた。

前回、合意採択が見送られたのは、２００９年にデンマークで開かれたＣＯＰ１５だ。「コペンハーゲン合意」を全会一致で採択できず、多国間の気候外交にとって打撃となった。

２０２６年下半期のＥＵ議長国アイルランドのダラ・オブライエン環境相は、科学者が地球温暖化の原因と指摘する化石燃料に全く触れていないことなどを理由にＥＵとして合意草案を支持できないと表明した。パナマも、気候危機の規模と緊急性に応えていないとして、草案を支持できないとした。

交渉を主導したオーストラリアと開催国トルコは、合意文書の草案を複数回示し、気候変動の影響を最も受けやすい国々と、化石燃料の生産や消費に経済を頼る国々の間で妥協点を探った。

２２日に示された最終草案は、気候変動対策の国際枠組み「パリ協定」が目指す産業革命前からの世界の気温上昇を１．５度に抑えるとの目標を超える軌道にあることを、初めて認めた上で、上限を超えた分を最終的に元に戻すため、二酸化炭素（ＣＯ２）除去技術の開発を急ぐよう求めていた。焦点となっていた気候変動の原因とされる化石燃料からの脱却には直接には触れず、その代わり、脱却を進めるとした過去の合意文書に言及した。

関係者の話では、サウジアラビアやその他の主要産油国が、文書に化石燃料の記載は入れず、炭素除去技術を盛り込むよう強く働きかけたという。一方、草案は野心に欠けるという批判が出た。

議長国は、各国が異議を申し立てるための時間を数時間設け、２２日中に全体会合を開き採択を目指していたが、意見の隔たりは埋まらなかった。

item.title: Exclusive-Like SpaceX, Anthropic ran an unusual IPO process, chafing some bankers
item.description: NEW YORK, Nov 22 : For the second time this year, Wall Street bankers and lawyers took home a massive paycheck from a record-setting initial public offering. And for the second time this year, some of them came out of it complaining in private about how the process was riddled with complications and unlike any they
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Exclusive-Like SpaceX, Anthropic ran an unusual IPO process, chafing some bankers

FILE PHOTO: An Anthropic, PBC (ANT) sign in Times Square on the day Anthropic held its initial public offering (IPO) at the NASDAQ Market site in New York City, US, November 19, 2026. REUTERS/Shannon Stapleton/File Photo

22 Nov 2026 07:02PM (Updated: 22 Nov 2026 08:54PM)

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 22 : For the second time this year, Wall Street bankers and lawyers took home a massive paycheck from a record-setting initial public offering. And for the second time this year, some of them came out of it complaining in private about how the process was riddled with complications and unlike any they had worked on before. With SpaceX’s IPO in June, in which banks earned half a billion dollars in fees, bankers chafed over how tightly the Elon Musk-led company controlled the months-long process and kept financial and other information private, making it hard for advisers to do their jobs.  As Anthropic’s IPO, dubbed internally “Project Lantern”, eclipsed SpaceX on Thursday and bankers took home more than half a billion dollars in fees, several people close to the process listed a litany of problems that had plagued the offering process: a compressed timeline, marred by last-minute changes and delays in sharing financial projections; rushed document approvals; and highly unusual restrictions on bankers and concern about leaks — especially after Reuters reported many details from a draft IPO filing weeks before it was made public. Anthropic, for example, instructed some of its 22 IPO underwriters to limit the number of bankers working on the deal to four, asking the firms to make sure they were senior staff, several people familiar with the matter said. One of the people said the restriction likely came out of fear that information would leak, and that the banks found a way to work around it anyway.

Underlying these complaints is a new power dynamic between technology companies and Wall Street. Companies such as SpaceX, Anthropic — and potentially also OpenAI in the future —  have come to wield enormous power as the transformative potential of artificial intelligence creates a frenzied demand for their shares, and they are wielding it to do things their way. That is upsetting some bankers. But banks and investors appear to have little choice but to play along. “These companies certainly did have some market power to tell underwriters that it’s not going to be business as usual,” said Jay Ritter, a University of Florida professor emeritus who researches IPOs. “But the big Wall Street firms, I suspect, are still going to be doing things as business as usual for all but maybe OpenAI (after these two deals).” Ritter added that both SpaceX and Anthropic had negotiated to pay underwriters nothing on the additional shares sold through the greenshoe option. “I don't think most companies are going to be able to demand zero spread on overallotment shares,” he said. Anthropic, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, the two lead underwriters on the two IPOs, declined to comment. SpaceX and OpenAI did not respond to requests for comment. Both SpaceX and Anthropic debuted successfully, raising record amounts of money, and their shares rallied initially. A key part of the underwriters’ job is to market the securities. Thanks to the demand for AI, that was an easy sell — both companies had order books oversubscribed many times over.  After an initial burst in shares, the trajectories of the two big AI firms diverged. SpaceX climbed to a post-listing peak of $201.80 on June 16 before retreating below its $135 IPO price for the first time in mid-July. Anthropic’s shares closed down 8.5 per cent on Friday after a 17 per cent first-day pop, as a dramatic unraveling of the AI trade showed that even a blockbuster listing could not shake the gloom hanging over the sector. UNUSUAL NON-COMPETES AND RESTRICTIONS In the case of SpaceX’s IPO, the people close to the process said Musk’s team dictated terms at every stage. Musk's team told the largest and most powerful US banks — including Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley — how to market SpaceX's stock and to whom. It told some banks the specific order sizes they needed to “fill” — in some cases a few billion dollars — and gave them instructions on what types of investors to bring. Banks signed on to underwrite the IPO without being told what they would be paid, the people said. The underlying current running through Anthropic’s IPO process was what several of the people who spoke to Reuters interpreted as a sense of extreme caution.     Anthropic asked some senior officers at banks working on its IPO to sign legal documents restricting core members of the transaction team from working with rival companies, including OpenAI, Cursor, DeepSeek and Hugging Face, for six months after it went public, according to the people.  Banks routinely manage conflicts and protect client confidentiality. But bankers and lawyers said it is rare for an IPO to impose exclusivity this broad, particularly on individual bankers.  In previous head-to-head IPOs such as those of ridesharing rivals Uber and Lyft, or real estate companies Trulia and Zillow, banks could simply pick a side, in part because the deals were smaller and required fewer banks.  Anthropic, by contrast, needed a broad syndicate to raise the enormous amount of capital it was seeking. That, some of the people said, explained why Anthropic sought to bind individual bankers with these restrictions.  One banker who declined to sign on to the agreement said it was a challenge to find people who could promise not to actively cover or engage with Anthropic’s peers, especially as several of those companies pursue their own initial or secondary offerings.   INFORMATION LEAKS AND LATE NIGHTS  Some of the restrictions were meant to control leaks of information.  Nearly four weeks before Anthropic’s filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, called Form S-1, was made public, Reuters reported on it, revealing details of the company’s financials, risk factors, dealings with other tech companies and other information.  Anthropic also used a product called NetRoadshow to share information, instead of regular PDFs, with most of the banks underwriting the deal.  NetRoadshow logs access details, including information such as who has seen the document and looked at which page. Documents on NetRoadshow also had individual bankers’ names as watermarks.  Leaks continued to surface in the press, but using NetRoadshow complicated bankers' work, including because the platform would not let them save copies of documents, one of the people said. Anthropic planned to file an updated securities filing, called an S-1A, with the SEC with the price range and to launch the marketing on November 10. To do so, it needed to send a draft to all the banks in its syndicate for them to sign off on it. The night before it was to happen, a law firm on the deal sent a PDF to the banks about the sale of shares in Canada. But soon it followed with another email asking them to disregard it, saying it “contains incorrect price range and share information,” according to the email, which was seen by Reuters.   The correct S-1A was then sent via the NetRoadshow platform around 2 a.m. New York time. Banks were told they had several hours to sign off on it before it was filed with the SEC.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ＣＯＰ３１議長国が合意文書の新草案、脱化石燃料に直接言及せず 合意不透明
item.description:
Tuvan Gumrukcu Ali Kucukgocmen
［アンタルヤ（トルコ） ２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tuvan Gumrukcu　Ali Kucukgocmen

［アンタルヤ（トルコ） ２２日　ロイター］ - トルコのアンタルヤで開催中の国連気候変動枠組み条約第３１回締約国会議（ＣＯＰ３１）は会期延長２日目となる２２日、共同議長国のトルコとオーストラリアが合意文書の新たな草案を公表した。各国の代表団が異議を申し立てられるよう数時間の猶予を設定した。合意案の承認手続きを始める会合を２２日中に開く予定だが、先行きは不透明。合意に至らない可能性も出ている。

新草案は、気候変動対策の国際枠組み「パリ協定」が目指す産業革命前からの世界の気温上昇を１．５度に抑えるとの目標を超える軌道にあることを、初めて認める。その上で、超過分を最終的に押し戻すため、炭素除去技術の開発加速を求める。焦点となっていた気候変動の原因とされる化石燃料からの脱却には直接には触れず、その代わり、脱却を進めるとした過去の合意文書に言及した。

協議に詳しい関係筋によると、サウジアラビアやその他の主要産油国は、文書に化石燃料の記載は入れず、炭素除去技術を盛り込むよう強く働きかけていたという。

ツバルのマイナ・タリア気候変動相は「まるでサウジと交渉しているようだ」と話した。 サウジ代表はコメントを控えた。

ＣＯＰ３１の議長を務めるトルコのムラト・クルム環境・都市計画・気候変動相は「われわれは、全ての締約国が合意できる文案を提示できたと考えている。妥協が見えてきている」と述べた。

しかし匿名を条件に取材に応じた複数の代表団は、合意しないまま会議を終える可能性に言及した。

環境団体「３５０．ｏｒｇ」は、草案が化石燃料に明示的に言及せず、炭素除去技術の推進を訴えている点に失望を表明。団体の幹部、サラ・ショー氏は「炭素回収はオーバーシュート時代で最大級の詐欺で、われわれの指導者はそれにだまされる寸前だ」と批判した。

二酸化炭素（ＣＯ２）を大気中に放出される前に取り込む炭素回収技術については、費用がかさむうえに大規模な実用化が実証されておらず、合意に盛り込めば石油・ガス開発の継続に道を開くことになるとの批判的な指摘も出ている。

item.title: Washington governor, union denounce ICE arrests of travellers at Seattle airport
item.description: The governor of Washington state denounced federal immigration authorities on Saturday (Nov 21) for arresting two people on a jetway at a Seattle-area airport.The incident involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers occurred around 8am PST at the Seattle-Tacoma International Airport as people board
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Washington governor, union denounce ICE arrests of travellers at Seattle airport

A person holds a sign as people gather for a protest at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport, after U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers arrested two people boarding an Alaska Airlines flight earlier in the day, in SeaTac, Washington, US on Nov 21, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/David Ryder)

FAST

The governor of Washington state denounced federal immigration authorities on Saturday (Nov 21) for arresting two people on a jetway at a Seattle-area airport. The incident involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers occurred around 8am PST at the Seattle-Tacoma International Airport as people boarded an Alaska Airlines flight to Los Angeles. ICE officers conducted an operation to arrest Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, who overstayed his visa, the agency said in a statement. The officers also arrested a second individual, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, who threw hot coffee at them, ICE said in a post on social media. Mejia had also overstayed her visa, ICE said, adding that she would be charged with assaulting a federal officer. Reuters was not able to identify lawyers for Mendoza or Mejia.

"ICE is completely and totally out of control and today we are confronted with yet more evidence of this," said Governor Bob Ferguson, a Democrat, at a news conference on Saturday. Video of the incident circulated on social media and news outlets is "horrific" and "chilling", Ferguson said, adding that he told Alaska Airlines representatives that “they need to call on ICE to get out of our airports." The governor said he would make the same request of every other airline that flies out of Sea-Tac airport. Alaska Airlines said it is "concerned" by the federal action. "Alaska Airlines was not provided advance notice of the enforcement action and we are working to understand the circumstances surrounding what occurred," the company said in a statement. April Sims, president of the Washington State Labor Council called the ICE arrest a "smash-and-grab" action that injected fear and chaos during a delicate time for air travel. "Just days after our nation experienced widespread disruptions to air travel and flights being grounded, federal agents chose to carry out this operation at one of our busiest airports, during one the busiest travel weeks of the year," Sims said in a statement sent by the union, which includes local chapters representing flight attendants and ground crew at Sea-Tac airport. Alaska Airlines said many passengers were put on other flights shortly after the incident and the originally scheduled flight departed at 11am.

Source: Reuters/nh

item.title: ＥＵ加盟国はロシア人の入国制限強化を、デンマークが提案 暗殺未遂受け
item.description:
John Irish
[パリ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
John Irish

[パリ ２１日 ロイター] - デンマークは、米ウクライナ二重国籍の男性ラッパーに対するロシアの暗殺計画を阻止したと発表したのに続き、欧州連合（ＥＵ）加盟国に文書を送り、ロシア国民への入国制限を強化するよう呼びかけた。外交関係者が文書の内容を確認した。

デンマークの警察と治安当局は２０日、ロシア情報機関が９月下旬にコペンハーゲンで公演を控えていた男性ラッパーの暗殺を企てたが、直前に関係する３人を逮捕したと明らかにした。ラスムセン外相はこれを「容認できない」と非難し、デンマーク政府はロシアの駐在武官の国外追放も発表した。

デンマークはＥＵ加盟国の外交担当者に２０日夜に送った文書で、欧州域内の自由な往来を保障するシェンゲン協定締結２９カ国への入国に関し、ロシア国民への観光ビザ（査証）の発給停止や、ロシアの非生体認証パスポートでの本人確認を停止することを提案した。

週明け２３日に開かれるＥＵの事務レベルの会議で提案を示す見通し。

item.title: ＮＢＡ＝クリッパーズ3連敗、八村19得点8リバウンドも及ばず
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）は２１日、各地で試合を行い、八村塁が所属するクリッパーズはマーベリックスに１００─１１０で敗れた。

先発した八村は約２９分プレーし、１９得点、８リバウンド、１アシストだった。クリッパーズは３連敗。

セブンティシクサーズはバックスを１３２─１２９で下し、５連勝。東カンファレンストップの１４勝３敗とした。シクサーズのジョエル・エンビードが２６得点、１７リバウンド、９アシストと活躍。レブロン・ジェームズが２１得点、６リバウンド、６アシスト、３スチールで貢献した。バックスはタイラー・ヒーローがキャリア最多の５０得点を挙げたが、１３連敗となった。

スパーズはビクター・ウェンバンヤマが５０得点、１９リバウンドと活躍し、ペリカンズに１１４─９１で快勝した。ティンバーウルブズはグリズリーズに１０４─９５で勝利。ニックスはトレイルブレーザーズに９７─９６で競り勝った。

item.title: テニス＝ＡＴＰファイナル、決勝はズベレフ対アルカラス
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスの今季ツアー最終戦、ＡＴＰファイナルは２１日、イタリアのトリノで準決勝を行い、決勝は世界ランキング１位のアレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）と世界３位のカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）という顔合わせになった。

ズベレフは第４シードでロシア出身のダニル・メドベージェフと対戦し、第１セットはタイブレークで７ポイントを連取して７─６でものにすると、第２セットは６─４で勝利。今大会では１セットも落とさずに決勝まで進んだ。

自身３回目のＡＴＰファイナル制覇を目指すズベレフは「どちらも信じられないほど素晴らしいサーブを打っていたので、（ブレークポイントは）ほとんどなかったような気がする。彼（メドベージェフ）をたたえたい」と話した。

アルカラスは第３シードのベン・シェルトン（米国）に３─６、６─３、７─６で逆転勝利。「第２セットでいいプレーをして巻き返せたのがとにかくうれしい。タイブレークでも素晴らしいテニスができて満足している。この勝利には大きな意味がある。明日が楽しみだ。今日は全てに満足している」と話した。

アルカラスは優勝すればＡＴＰファイナル初タイトル。ズベレフとの対戦成績は７勝６敗としており、ことしの全豪オープン準決勝でもフルセットの末に勝利を収めている。

item.title: サッカー＝レアル、エムバペＰＫ失敗もセルタに逆転勝ち
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部は２１日、各地で試合を行い、レアル・マドリードがセルタに２─１で勝利し、翌日に試合を控える首位バルセロナと暫定ながら勝ち点３３で並んだ。

前半６分に失点したレアルは、同３９分にキリアン・エムバペが自ら得たＰＫで同点のチャンスを得るも、これを失敗。同選手がレアルとフランス代表での試合中にＰＫを外したのは直近６回中これが３回目となった。

レアルは後半２１分、エムバペのアシストからジュード・ベリンガムが同点弾をマークすると、同４０分にカルロス・エスピが決勝ゴールを決めた。

佐藤龍之介が所属するバレンシアはラヨ・バリェカノに１─０で勝利し、暫定１７位に浮上して降格圏内を脱出。佐藤はベンチ入りしたが出番はなかった。

その他、セビリアとベティスのダービーは１─１のドロー。アラベスはデポルティボに３─１で勝利した。

item.title: ノルディックスキー＝Ｗ杯ジャンプ個人第1戦で小林陵8位、丸山9位
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - ノルディックスキーのワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）ジャンプは２１日、リレハンメルで男女の個人第１戦（ヒルサイズ＝ＨＳ１４０メートル）を行い、男子では小林陵侑が８位だった。

小林は１回目に１３５メートル、２回目に１２６．５メートルを飛び、合計２４４．２点だった。シュテファン・エンバハー（オーストリア）が合計２７８．０点で優勝した。中村直幹は１１位、佐藤幸椰は２３位。二階堂蓮は２回目に進めず、３７位に終わった。

女子では丸山希が合計２１６．８点で９位。宮嶋林湖は１１位、勢藤優花は１４位、伊藤有希は１９位で、高梨沙羅は２回目に進めずに３５位だった。優勝したアイリンマリア・クバンダルを含め、５位までノルウェー勢が独占した。

item.title: Anthropic's post-debut stumble delivers reality check for AI trade
item.description: Anthropic’s shares fell about 9% after their market debut, deepening concerns over stretched AI valuations and showing that even a marquee listing has not revived investor enthusiasm for the sector. The focus is now shifting to whether Anthropic can justify its roughly 40-times-sales valuation and whether a potential OpenAI IPO next year can restore appetite for AI stocks.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anthropic's post-listing slide deepened the gloom over the AI sector on Friday, underscoring how even one of the most eagerly anticipated listings in history has struggled to revive investor enthusiasm.Widely seen as a proxy for the AI trade, Anthropic's listing had been viewed as a potential boost for an industry struggling to regain momentum after a turbulent stretch.But the stock was last trading at $88.87, about 9% below where it closed following Thursday's smooth debut, giving Anthropic a fully diluted valuation of about $1.6 trillion and a market capitalization of $1.2 trillion based on shares outstanding.The stock could find support later in the year. London-based index rebalance analytics firm Intropic estimates index-tracking funds could account for purchases of up to 30% of Anthropic's shares by year-end.Near-term volatility, however, could persist as the initial euphoria around the listing fades and investors assess whether a valuation of about 40 times sales over the past 12 months can be sustained. We favor patience on Anthropic and recommend evaluating the company as it reports public results, said Kaush Amin, head of private market investing at US Bank Asset Management, adding that the current valuation assumes years of rapid growth. The debut has also done little to ease broader concerns about the health of the AI trade. Wall Street's main indexes ended sharply lower on Thursday, while futures pointed to further declines on Friday.Among the Magnificent Seven stocks, Nvidia and Meta Platforms fell more than 2% each in premarket trading, while Amazon and Microsoft dropped more than 1%.Chip stocks also slid, with AMD and Sandisk down 7% each and Intel losing more than 5%.The focus now shifts to a potential OpenAI listing, which would be another major test of investors' appetite for AI stocks. OpenAI has indicated it may go public next year.PARALLELS WITH SPACEXAnthropic's IPO has drawn parallels with Elon Musk's SpaceX , which went public in June after the second-biggest IPO on record.While the companies have different business models, some investors have pointed to SpaceX's sharp swings in the weeks after its debut as a reason for caution over buying Anthropic immediately after its listing. There's going to be some volatility like we had with SpaceX. A lot of people are going to have FOMO. I don't think there's any need to get on it on the first trade, said Rob Hackel, CEO of financial advisory and brokerage firm RF Lafferty & Co.SpaceX shares fell about 5%.Retail investors traded about $772 million of Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most for an IPO debut since Vanda Research began tracking the data in 2012.The stock's sharp swings have left investors weighing whether to bet on a rebound or brace for further losses. Options trading, due to begin next week, could add to the volatility. It's not a good environment for Anthropic at the moment, said Carsten Hesse, head of index events at Berenberg.Competition could also weigh on investor sentiment.Apple is developing an AI agent that can perform tasks on behalf of users, entering a market already being pursued by OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, Bloomberg News reported on Friday.

item.title: ラグビー＝ネーションズ選手権、日本はスコットランドに大敗
item.description: ［エディンバラ ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［エディンバラ　２１日　ロイター］ - ラグビーの強豪１２カ国・地域で争う国際大会、ネーションズ選手権は２１日、英国のエディンバラなどで試合を行い、世界ランキング１２位の日本代表は同６位のスコットランド代表に５─６７で大敗した。

日本はスピードとパワーで圧倒され、合計１１トライを献上。前半に０─２９と大差をつけられると、後半にも失点を重ね、松永拓朗による１トライにとどまった。

同大会では北半球と南半球のチームが戦い、南の一員として参戦している日本は１勝５敗で５位。北のスコットランドは４勝２敗で４位となった。

エディー・ジョーンズ・ヘッドコーチ率いる日本は１１月に入って３戦全敗。７日はウェールズに２１─２８で敗れ、１４日はイングランドに１５─７８の完敗を喫していた。

item.title: サッカー＝坂元が強烈ミドルで今季2点目、コベントリーがパレス下す
item.description: ［マンチェスター（英国） ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［マンチェスター（英国）　２１日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは２１日、各地で試合を行い、坂元達裕がフル出場したコベントリーが鎌田大地フル出場のクリスタルパレスに３─２で競り勝った。

コベントリーは１─１と追い付かれて迎えた前半３０分、ペナルティーエリアの外でボールを受けた坂元が胸トラップから左足で強烈なミドルシュートをたたき込み、リーグ戦今季２ゴール目。チームは同アディショナルタイムに再び同点とされたが、最後は相手のオウンゴールで勝利を収めた。

最下位のクリスタルパレスはこれで今季８敗目。トーマス・フランク監督の初陣を白星で飾ることができなかった。クリスタルパレスの冨安健洋はベンチ外。

田中碧が先発したリーズはチェルシーを４─１で撃破。前半２５分に先制されたが、ノア・オカフォーの２ゴールなどで逆転勝利を収めた。チェルシーはリーグ戦直近４試合で３敗目となった。田中は後半４１分までプレーした。

ＧＫ鈴木彩艶がフル出場したアストンビラはサンダーランドとスコアレスドローに終わった。前田大然が先発し後半１１分までプレーしたイプスウィッチは、トットナムに０─２で完敗した。

アーセナルはニューカッスルと２─２の引き分けに終わり、勝ち点を積み上げるチャンスを逸した。マンチェスター・シティーはフラムと１─１のドローで試合を終え、リーグ戦４連敗を免れた。

１１試合消化時点で首位アーセナルは勝ち点２８。リーズは同１７として６位に浮上した。コベントリーは同１２で１３位となった。

item.title: フィギュア＝フィンランディア杯、男子の友野は3位 セレブコ初優勝
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - フィギュアスケートのグランプリ（ＧＰ）シリーズ第５戦、フィンランディア杯は２１日、フィンランドのヘルシンキで競技を行い、男子では友野一希が合計２３７．７５点で３位に入った。

前日のショートプログラム（ＳＰ）で５位だった友野は、この日に行われたフリーでは４位だった。

ミハイル・セレブコ（エストニア）がＳＰに続き、フリーでも１位となり、合計２５４．９９点でＧＰ初優勝を達成。ファイナル進出を決めた。アンドレアス・ノルデバック（スウェーデン）がＳＰ同様、フリーでも３位となり、合計２４０．９４点の２位だった。

item.title: メキシコ、麻薬組織の首領を拘束 米当局が協力
item.description:
Sarah Kinosian
[メキシコ市 ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sarah Kinosian

[メキシコ市 ２１日 ロイター] - メキシコ当局は２１日、軍が２０日夜に麻薬組織の首領ファウスト・イシドロ・メサフロレス容疑者（通称エル・チャポ・イシドロ）を北西部シナロア州で拘束したと発表した。容疑者は米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）の最重要指名手配者１０人の一人。

メキシコ国防省はＸへの投稿で、軍の特殊部隊と国家警備隊による拘束作戦には米国の情報機関も協力したと明らかにした。メキシコ政府はトランプ米政権の圧力を受け、麻薬組織の取り締まりを強化している。

米国務省によると、メサフロレス容疑者とその麻薬組織「ベルトラン・レイバ」は２０年以上にわたり、ヘロイン、メタンフェタミン、コカイン、マリフアナ（大麻）を米国へ大量に密輸してきた。内部抗争が起きている別の麻薬組織「シナロア・カルテル」の派閥の一つと協力関係にあるという。

米国土安全保障捜査局（ＨＳＩ）はＸで、この作戦が「メキシコで最も強力なカルテルネットワークの一つに重大な打撃を与えた」と投稿。米北方軍もメキシコ軍を称えた。

item.title: Bahrain says Iranian attack hits industrial facility as air defences intercept attacks
item.description: The incidents were the latest escalation of regional hostilities since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Bahrain says Iranian attack hits industrial facility as air defences intercept attacks

The incidents were the latest escalation of regional hostilities since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February.

Visitors walk in front of Matam Rajab in downtown Manama, Bahrain, Nov 6, 2026. Picture taken with a mobile phone. (File photo: REUTERS/Hamad I Mohammed)

FAST

Bahrain said on Saturday (Nov 21) that an Iranian attack had hit a civilian industrial facility, causing a fire but no injuries, while Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they launched a missile-and-drone attack on US military positions in the kingdom, home to the US Navy's Fifth Fleet. The incidents were the latest escalation of regional hostilities since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February. Since then, Gulf Arab states have been drawn into the conflict, and there have been repeated Iranian attacks across the region. Civil Defence teams were working to contain the fire at the industrial facility, the ministry said in a post on X. It gave no details on the location or nature of the site. Bahrain's interior ministry initially issued an alert urging residents to move to the nearest safe location because of a potential threat, without providing details. It later issued an all-clear before sending a second alert.

Later, Bahrain's Defence Force said its air defences had intercepted a number of Iranian aerial attacks. Shrapnel from the interceptions caused material damage but no casualties, it said, adding that Tehran was continuing its "systematic hostile approach" towards the kingdom. The Revolutionary Guards, in a statement carried by Iranian state news agency IRNA, said their aerospace forces had launched a combined missile-and-drone attack on US positions at the Al-Riffa and Awali bases "in retaliation for ongoing aggression and repeated violations of Iranian airspace". US Central Command did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment on the Guards' account. Bahrain has reported intercepting several Iranian aerial attacks in recent days. Gulf Arab states have come under repeated fire from Tehran since the war broke out.

item.title: ゴルフ＝ＣＭＥツアー選手権、吉田が首位と1打差の2位に浮上
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフの今季最終戦、ＣＭＥツアー選手権は２１日、フロリダ州ネープルズのティブロンＧＣ（パー７２）で第３ラウンドを行い、吉田優利が２位に浮上した。

３位でスタートした吉田は６バーディー、ノーボギーの６６をマーク。通算１７アンダーの１９９に伸ばし、単独首位の金阿林（韓国）とは１打差につけた。

岩井明愛は５バーディー、ノーボギーの６７でラウンドし、通算１５アンダーの６位に浮上。山下美夢有も６７で回り、通算１４アンダーの７位に順位を上げた。

竹田麗央は通算１２アンダーの１５位。西郷真央と古江彩佳は通算８アンダーの２６位。西村優菜は通算６アンダーの３３位。岩井千怜と勝みなみは３７位、原英莉花と畑岡奈紗は４４位となった。

item.title: Ｆ１＝ラスベガスＧＰ予選、フェルスタッペンがＰＰ獲得
item.description: ［ラスベガス ２０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ラスベガス　２０日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の第２１戦、ラスベガス・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は２０日、予選を行い、マックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ、レッドブル）がポールポジション（ＰＰ）を獲得した。

総合優勝４回を誇るフェルスタッペンのＰＰ獲得は今季３回目で、キャリア通算５１回目。

すでに史上最年少での総合優勝を決めているキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）が最速タイムを計測したが、エンジン関連のペナルティーで５グリッド降格し、決勝では６番手からスタートする。

これを受けて、２番手のフェルスタッペン、３番手のジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）、４番手のランド・ノリス（英国、マクラーレン）、５番手のアイザック・ハジャー（フランス、レッドブル）、６番手のアービッド・リンドブラッド（英国、レーシングブルズ）がそれぞれ１つずつ繰り上がる。

item.title: フィギュア＝フィンランディア杯、女子の島田2連勝でファイナル進出
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - フィギュアスケートのグランプリ（ＧＰ）シリーズ第５戦、フィンランディア杯は２１日、フィンランドのヘルシンキで競技を行い、女子では島田麻央が第２戦のスケートカナダに続く２連勝を達成。シリーズ上位６人で争われるＧＰファイナル（中国・重慶で１２月１０─１２日に開催）初進出を決めた。

ショートプログラム（ＳＰ）首位の島田は、この日のフリーでは冒頭のトリプルアクセル（３回転半ジャンプ）に成功。さらにステップやスピンで最高難度のレベル４を獲得するなどし、合計２２９．４９点をマークした。

日本選手によるＧＰデビューからの２連勝は２０１８年の紀平梨花以来で、２人目となった。今季ＧＰシリーズでは日本勢が５戦全勝。第１戦と第４戦では中井亜美、第３戦では千葉百音が優勝した。

ニーナ・ペトロキナ（エストニア）が合計２１４．０６点で２位、イザボー・レビト（米国）が合計２０７．１９点で３位に入った。住吉りをんは７位、渡辺倫果は１０位に終わった。

item.title: イラン、バーレーンの工業施設攻撃、2人負傷 「米軍施設標的」と革命防衛隊
item.description: ［２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２２日　ロイター］ - バーレーンは２１日、民間の工業施設がイランの攻撃を受け火災が発生したと発表した。イランの精鋭部隊、イスラム革命防衛隊は、バーレーン国内の米軍陣地に対しミサイルと無人機による攻撃を実施したと表明した。

バーレーンには米海軍第５艦隊が拠点があり、ここ１週間、イランの攻撃を複数回受けている。

バーレーン内務省は２２日、前日のイランによる攻撃で２人が負傷したと明らかにした。パキスタン人が重体でバーレーン市民は容体は安定していると説明した。

同省は２１日、具体的内容には触れず、潜在的な脅威があるとして住民に避難を呼びかける警報を発令。警報はいったん解除されたが、再び出された。

その後、バーレーン国防軍は、防空部隊がイランによる複数の空中攻撃を迎撃したと発表した。迎撃による破片で物的被害が出たものの、死傷者の報告はないとした。国防軍は、イラン政府がバーレーンに対する「組織的な敵対的アプローチ」を続けていると指摘した。

一方、イランの革命防衛隊は国営イラン通信（ＩＲＮＡ）が伝えた声明で、「継続的な侵略とイラン領空への度重なる侵犯に対する報復」として、リファー基地およびアワリ基地の米軍施設に対し、宇宙航空部隊がミサイルと無人機による複合攻撃を実施したと発表した。

米中央軍は、革命防衛隊の説明に関するロイターのコメント要請に回答していない。

item.title: ロシア貨物船に無人機攻撃、ウクライナ関与か フィンランド領海で火災
item.description:
Essi Lehto
［ヘルシンキ ２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Essi Lehto

［ヘルシンキ　２２日　ロイター］ - ロシア軍と関係のあるロシアの貨物船が２１日、バルト海で無人機（ドローン）による攻撃を受けて火災を起こした。フィンランド沿岸警備隊は２２日、消火活動が行われているものの夜間を通じて燃え続けていると発表した。フィンランド軍は、攻撃はウクライナが実行した可能性が高いとの見解を示している。

貨物船は「スパルタ２」。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、ロシア国防省向けに物流サービスを提供しているロシアの海運会社オボロンロジスティカが所有する。米国の制裁対象になっている。

フィンランド軍によると、スパルタ２はロシア領ゴーグラント島の西の公海上で攻撃を受けて損傷し、フィンランド領海内に漂流した。現在も領海内でいかりを下ろしている。乗組員１６人は近くにいたロシア船に避難した。

ウクライナは今年に入り、ロシア北西部レニングラード州に向けて軍用無人機による波状攻撃を繰り返している。一部の無人機はバルト海地域の領空に入り込み、戦争が北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の領域に影響を及ぼしているとの懸念が出ている。

オルポ首相はＸに「戦争が近隣地域に波及しつつある。フィンランド当局は、無人機攻撃でロシアの商船が被弾したフィンランド湾の状況に対応している。ウクライナには侵略者と戦う権利がある」と投稿した。

エストニアのミハル首相はＸに「ロシアの侵略と戦うことの影響がバルト海に及んだ。侵略者に（侵略を）やめるよう求める新たなシグナルだ。だが、われわれのウクライナ支援を止めるものは何もない」と投稿した。

エストニア海軍司令官のイボ・バルク氏は２２日、フィンランド湾でさらなる攻撃が行われるリスクは排除できないと公共放送ＥＲＲに語った。

item.title: Russian cargo ship hit by drones in Baltic, Finland tightens security
item.description: “The war is spilling over into our neighbouring areas,” Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo says after a drone strike hits the Russian cargo ship Sparta II.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Russian cargo ship hit by drones in Baltic, Finland tightens security

“The war is spilling over into our neighbouring areas,” Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo says after a drone strike hits the Russian cargo ship Sparta II.

The damaged Russian cargo ship Sparta II, in a location given as the Gulf of Finland, November 21, 2026. FINNISH BORDER GUARD/Handout via REUTERS

FAST

HELSINKI: A Russian cargo ship caught fire after being hit by drones in the Baltic Sea on Saturday ( Nov 21) and later drifted into Finnish waters, prompting Helsinki to impose temporary air and maritime restrictions and say Ukraine was probably behind the attack. The Sparta II, bound for Russian exclave Kaliningrad , was damaged in international waters west of Russia's Gogland island, Finland 's Defence Forces said, corroborating an earlier account by Russian officials. "It is likely that Ukraine...is behind (the attack)," Finnish armed forces spokesperson Aki-Mauri Huhtinen told a press conference, adding it was not clear why the vessel had been targeted. Finland 's Border Guard said there was no danger to maritime traffic or people, that rescue units were at the scene, and that it was coordinating operations with neighbouring countries.

Gulf of Finland coast guard commander Mikko Simola later told a press conference the vessel had anchored and its crew was evacuating. Helsinki said it had introduced temporary aviation and maritime restrictions in the eastern Gulf of Finland to protect civilians and allow authorities to operate if drones needed to be intercepted. "The war is spilling over into our neighbouring areas. Finnish authorities are handling the situation in the Gulf of Finland , where a drone strike has hit a Russian merchant vessel. Ukraine has the right to fight against the aggressor," Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said on X. Ukraine's foreign ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Russia's embassy in Helsinki did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The vessel is subject to US sanctions and is linked to Russian ship ping company Oboronlogistika, according to the US Treasury Department. Oboronlogistika provides logistics services for the Russian defence ministry, according to the company's website. "At the moment, there is no confirmed information about what cargo is on board, but it cannot be ruled out that there is military materiel on board," Finnish Border Guard Commander Ilja Iljin told Reuters. Helsinki said separately that a Russian helicopter was suspected of violating Finnish airspace on Saturday, possibly in connection with rescue or monitoring operations involving the damaged vessel.

Related:

Russia pummels Ukraine after Putin vowed 'painful' attack

Ukraine's allies meet in Berlin after Trump-Putin-Xi talks

Ukraine strikes Crimean Bridge for third time in a week ahead of US-China-Russia summit

RUSSIA SAYS DRONES SHOT DOWN OVER LENINGRAD REGION Leningrad region Governor Aleksandr Drozdenko said on Telegram that a cargo vessel had been attacked by two drones in international waters about 3 nautical miles from Russia's border. He did not identify the vessel. Drozdenko also said 80 drones had been shot down over the Leningrad region overnight. Finland 's military said last week it had detected a strike on a Russian war ship in the same area during a wave of Ukrainian drone attacks on the Leningrad region. Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson said on X his country was monitoring the situation and had offered assistance to Finland , without providing details. Estonia's Police and Border Guard Board said in an emailed statement that preliminary information indicated there had been explosions on board the Sparta II, and that it was also monitoring the situation. Kaliningrad Governor Alexei Besprozvannykh said the incident posed no threat to supplies to the region. Kaliningrad , which lies between Poland and Lithuania, has periodically been a flashpoint between Russia and NATO and the European Union. Russia has previously described attacks on its commercial vessels outside its territorial waters as acts of terrorism and maritime piracy. The Sparta II is a 121-metre Russian-flagged cargo vessel owned by Oboronlogistika that left St Petersburg on Friday, according to LSEG data. The Gulf of Finland is a narrow arm of the Baltic Sea between Finland and Estonia that extends east to St Petersburg. Gogland lies in the eastern Gulf of Finland , about 40 km from Finland 's coast.

Source: Reuters/fs

item.title: ＡＢＢロボット事業、ソフトバンクＧへの売却頓挫なら上場も 中国阻止で
item.description:
Anousha Sakoui Oliver Hirt John Revill
［ロンドン／チューリッヒ ２０日 ロイ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＢＢロボット事業、ソフトバンクＧへの売却頓挫なら上場も　中国阻止で 11/21 18:40 配信

スイス・チューリッヒで2020年9月撮影　REUTERS/Arnd Wiegmann/File Photo（ロイター） Anousha Sakoui　Oliver Hirt　John Revill

［ロンドン／チューリッヒ　２０日　ロイター］ - スイスの重電大手ＡＢＢが、ソフトバンクグループ（ＳＢＧ）に売却する予定のロボット事業について、中国が売却計画を阻止したことを受け、計画が白紙になった場合に上場させることを検討していることが分かった。事情に詳しい関係者２人が明らかにした。

中国当局の阻止は、ＳＢＧと欧米企業との関係や、機密データが米国に移転されるリスクを懸念したためとされる。ＳＢＧはオープンＡＩの主要投資家となっている。

関係者によると、ＡＢＢとＳＢＧは計画の修正に取り組んでおり、ロボット事業の約３０％を占める中国事業を切り離し、中国企業に売却するか上場させる案が出ている。それがうまくいかなければ、ＡＢＢはロボット事業をスピンオフ（分離・独立）するか、別の相手に売却することを視野に置いている。

ただ、両社は取引の成立を最優先に考えているという。今後数週間で打開策を見出したいと考えているが、協議は２０２７年にずれ込む可能性もあると関係者は話した。

関係者の１人によると、ＳＢＧは違約金を負う可能性がある。違約金の条件は開示されていない。

ＡＢＢとＳＢＧはコメントを控えた。

中国政府は、ＡＩ開発の主導権を巡る米国との競争が激しくなる中、最先端技術が絡む買収案件を厳格に審査している。４月には米メタが、ＡＩスタートアップのＭａｎｕｓ（マナス）買収の撤回を命じられた。

ＡＢＢは中国の１３０近い都市で約３０の現地法人を運営し、従業員は１万５０００人に上る。同社のウェブサイトによると、ＡＢＢエンジニアリング（上海）にはロボット事業のグローバル本部が置かれ、重要な研究開発・生産拠点になっている。

ＳＢＧは１０月初旬にＡＢＢのロボット事業買収を発表した際、買収によって「当社のＡＩロボット事業を飛躍的に強化する」と説明していた。破談となれば打撃となる。

item.title: 米ＦＢＩの犯罪情報データベースにハッキング、ＣＮＮ報道
item.description: [２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２０日 ロイター] - ＣＮＮは２０日、関係筋２人の話として、連邦、州、地方の法執行機関が刑事司法情報を共有するために使用する全国規模のデータベースへの不正アクセスが疑われる件について、米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）が捜査を行っていると報じた。

全米犯罪情報センター（ＮＣＩＣ）のデータベースが侵害されたとみられるこの事案は、ここ数カ月でＦＢＩのシステムに関する２件目の侵入となる。９月にはＦＢＩの求人サイトが不正アクセスを受け、現職員および元職員のデータが流出した。

ＦＢＩはロイターのコメント要請に応じなかった。

ＦＢＩのデータベースは、令状、犯罪歴、身元調査に関する情報を保存・共有するために、全国の法執行機関によって利用されている。

item.title: 仏インフレ率、明らかに高過ぎ＝中銀総裁
item.description: [パリ ２０日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのムーラン仏中銀総裁は２０日、フランスの現在の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
仏インフレ率、明らかに高過ぎ＝中銀総裁 11/21 15:34 配信

[パリ ２０日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのムーラン仏中銀総裁は２０日、フランスの現在のインフレ率は「明らかに高過ぎる」とし、ＥＣＢの使命はこれを引き下げることだと述べた。

仏テレビ局「フランス５」のインタビューで、インフレ率は３．８％近くに達しており、「あるべき水準」と比較して高過ぎると語った。

また、フランスは債務と財政赤字を制御し続けるべきであり、今年よりも赤字幅を縮小した来年の予算案の承認が不可欠だと付け加えた。

item.title: 孫正義氏、ＳＫハイニックスの1兆ドル買収を一時検討＝メディア
item.description: [２０日 ロイター] - ニュースメディア「ジ・インフォメーション」は２０日、事情に詳しい複数の関係筋の話として、ソ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
孫正義氏、ＳＫハイニックスの1兆ドル買収を一時検討＝メディア 11/21 15:18 配信

写真は孫正義氏。７月に都内で撮影(２０２６年　ロイター/Kim Kyung-Hoon)（ロイター） [２０日 ロイター] - ニュースメディア「ジ・インフォメーション」は２０日、事情に詳しい複数の関係筋の話として、ソフトバンクグループの孫正義最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が最近、韓国の半導体メモリー大手ＳＫハイニックスを１兆ドル規模で買収する可能性について、ウォール街の金融機関に資金調達を打診したと報じた。

同メディアによると、ソフトバンクＧの広報担当者は「当社は多くの機会を模索している。この件についてはもはや積極的に検討していない」と述べた。

一方、ＳＫハイニックスは声明で、ジ・インフォメーションの報道で言及された件については承知していないと述べた。

また、韓国法に基づき、自社に対する海外企業による買収には事前の政府承認が必要になると付け加えた。

ソフトバンクＧの広報担当者はロイターのコメント要請に対し、ジ・インフォメーションに提供したコメントを参照するよう求めた。

FAST

Nov 21 : Bitcoin, the world's largest cryptocurrency by market value, rose more than 8 per cent to around $59,952 on Saturday, after sliding to its lowest level in two years earlier in the day.  It briefly crossed $60,000 at around 8:30 a.m. EST (1330 GMT).  Bitcoin had fallen to $55,251.60 earlier in the day, its lowest level in two years, after breaking below $57,742 on Friday for the first time since September 2024 as stretched valuations in artificial intelligence stocks rattled investors and weighed on other risk assets.  Crypto markets have been shaken in recent sessions by weeks of concern about the profitability of massive AI infrastructure spending, rising borrowing costs, regulatory risks following Democrats' win in the US midterm elections and the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.
